svg.title: I'm Abhishek, an Engineering Management master's student at Politecnico di Torino, with a B.Sc. in Computer Engineering from the same place. I like the seam between engineering and business: taking something technical, understanding who it is for, and shipping it. Before this I built a VR property-visualisation platform as a Technical Management Trainee at OpenSky VR Italia, and spent a year and a half as a Junior Data Analyst at Fibzio turning SQL and Power BI into decisions. On the side I lead the Politecnico Indian Students Association, which reaches more than a thousand students. In 2026 I stood on three hackathon podiums.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', 'Times New Roman', serif
